Orange County’s name has a juicy story! 🍊 “Orange [image: Orange County’s name has a juicy story! 🍊 “Orange County” was proposed in 1872, when oranges promised prosperity and helped promote the region as an agricultural paradise. Today, OC is known for so much more: Disneyland, beautiful beaches and surf, and a thriving biotech and life sciences community. From the coast to the lab, Orange County is full of California energy! #OrangeCounty #California #Disneyland #Beaches #Surfing #Biotech #LifeSciences #58Counties1California #StrongerTogether]
